segments.input:
New film from the director.
Brief: A 20-second 1080p rooftop chase at night: a courier named Juno sprints across wet rooftops, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape. Keep it at 1080p.
Target length: 20 s. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Clips at 1080p. Budget: 20 credits.
Plan it and run production. Stop where the decisions are the director's.

input.title: Gap Jump
input.logline: A courier named Juno sprints across wet night rooftops, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape.

look.style: Cinematic neon-noir, wet reflective surfaces, handheld energy

elements.name: Juno
elements.description: Young courier, yellow rain jacket, dark cargo pants, black sneakers, messenger bag with red strap, short dark hair

elements.name: Wet Rooftops
elements.description: City rooftops at night, wet tar surfaces reflecting neon, vents and water tanks, a wide gap between buildings

elements.name: Fire Escape
elements.description: Rusted black iron fire escape on a brick building, wet metal grating, neon glow from below

scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno in a yellow jacket sprints across a wet rooftop, splashes kicking up, neon reflecting on the tar.

scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno reaches the roof edge and leaps across a wide gap, city lights glowing far below.

scenes.heading: EXT. FIRE ESCAPE - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno lands hard on the iron fire escape grating, the metal rattles, and Juno grips the rail, chest heaving.

input.message: Full plan at 1080p with pro models costs 169 credits; budget is 20. Even the cheapest route can't hold 1080p. How should I proceed?

options.label: Keep 1080p, raise budget to 169
options.detail: Full pro plan, 3 scenes, 20 s at 1080p.

options.label: 720p pro clips, fast drafts
options.detail: Lowers resolution to 720p; fast images for looks and frames, sim-video-pro 720p. Still over 20.

options.label: 720p lite clips, fast images
options.detail: Cheapest: sim-video-lite 720p at 20 s plus fast images. Still over 20.

turns.text:
The plan is written, but I haven't rendered anything. At 1080p it costs 169 credits and your budget is 20.

The plan is three scenes totalling 20 s:
- **Scene 1 (7 s):** Juno sprints across the wet rooftops.
- **Scene 2 (6 s):** Juno leaps the gap.
- **Scene 3 (7 s):** Juno lands on the fire escape.

The library had no matching rooftop or fire escape, so all three looks (Juno and the two locations) would need new renders.

I've asked you to choose how to proceed. The options I put to you were:
- **Raise the budget to 169:** this keeps 1080p.
- **720p pro clips with fast images:** about 106 credits, which is still over 20.
- **720p lite clips with fast images:** about 72 credits, which is still over 20.

I won't lower the resolution unless you say so.
